card.name: Space before a number in labels
card.fires_on: A space token right before a digit in drug-label text: a section number, a figure or type number, or the second number in a range.

modes.label: Section numbers
modes.description: Space after a sentence ends, just before a numbered heading such as 5.3 or 5.4.
modes.example: or diabetes.<< >>5.3 Cardiovascular Diseases Increased risk

modes.label: Type or figure numbers
modes.description: Space after the word Type or figure, before the digit or numeral.

modes.label: Ranges
modes.description: Space after "to" in a percentage range, before the second number.

card.plain: It fires on the blank space that comes just before a number in label headings, types, figures and ranges.
